description: Aligned conditions preserve the restored original witness during reconstruction (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b
%rule a $x:body %conditions $x.without-elision.matches(rival)

%rule body (X [+T])
%rule b (X [+T] [+U])
%rule rival (X [+T])
